Ava (Marketing): Draft for the product launch blog is live: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus on Redwood Optimize, short benchmark note, tiny embeddings example, and CTA routing. Need legal + sales review by EOD Wed.

Diego (Content): Pasting minimal embed example to include: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{\"model\":\"open-embedding-mini\",\"input\":\"Summarize Redwood Optimize benefits\"}'
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass: remove hard numeric claims (e.g., "5x"). Replace with conservative language like "dramatically lower per-token cost with batching and caching". Reword SLA mentions to "where contracted". Approve after edits.

Sam (Sales): CTA routing needed: Request a demo -> HubSpot form hb-102 (AE: enterprise); Try Hosted API -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth SDR); Webinar -> Eventbrite -> HubSpot list (tag: webinar_reg). Flag webinar regs as MQL if company_size > 50.

Ava (Marketing): Added CTA mapping and ops note about webinar tagging in the doc and playbook.
